"""Prepare a following finite run only AFTER v5 actually ends safely."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.rolling_production_queue import no_calling
from tools.production_window_gate import inspect_window
previous='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v5';following='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v6'
folder=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production';old_path=folder/(previous+'.json')
old=read_json(old_path)
assert old['machine_id']==machine_id() and old['status']=='stopped_at_safe_boundary'
assert old['reason']=='bounded_transport_or_run_duration','User/auth/reconciliation stop is not an automatic phase continuation'
assert not (folder/'owner.json').exists()
assert read_json(folder/(previous+'-released-owner.json'))=={'run_id':previous,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert not (folder/(following+'.json')).exists()
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists()
no_calling(ROOT)
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/retry-scheduler/state.json')['pending'] is None
assert inspect_window(ROOT,old['after_window'],machine_id())['ready']
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches']
assert 0<=old['next_index']<=len(plan)
count=png=content=auth=0
for path in (ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings').glob(previous+'-window*-completed.json'):
    receipt=read_json(path);assert receipt['status']=='completed'
    resolved=[e for e in receipt['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved']
    count+=len(resolved)
    png+=sum(e['error'] is None for e in resolved)
    content+=sum('moderation_blocked' in (e['error'] or '') for e in resolved)
    auth+=sum('token_expired' in (e['error'] or '') for e in resolved)
assert count==old['completed_source_requests'] and count==png+content+auth
spec={'runId':following,'startIndex':old['next_index'],'afterWindow':old['after_window'],'maxCalls':64,'maxPreviewBytes':6553600,'maxRunSeconds':7200}
spec_path=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v6-spec-20261025.json';assert not spec_path.exists()
audit_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v6.json';assert not audit_path.exists()
write_json(spec_path,spec)
write_json(audit_path,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'previous_run':previous,'previous_state':old,'previous_state_sha256':file_sha256(old_path),'previous_actual_invocations':count,'previous_actual_PNG_returns':png,'previous_content_refusals':content,'previous_authentication_errors':auth,'following_run':following,'following_spec':spec,'following_spec_sha256':file_sha256(spec_path),'status':'following_finite_run_prepared_owner_not_yet_claimed','user_scope':'Continue user-authorized LOW production with builtin imagegen and HIGH refusal skip. Previous unique Git-only publisher must finish/read back and release its lock before the next publisher can start; generation does not await publication.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
